boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Mary's College
boards.description: Ten currently listed food destinations in the South Bend–Notre Dame area with late closing times.

cards.title: Nick's Patio
cards.subtitle: 1710 N Ironwood Dr, South Bend
cards.notes: Choose this diner when you need a sit-down meal at an unusual hour; confirm service details directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner option on Ironwood Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Nick's Patio at 1710 N Ironwood Dr as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24 hours daily; hours can change.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Brick Road
cards.subtitle: 6225 W Brick Rd, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or counter for a customizable late meal; check the location page for the day-specific closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Brick Road Taco Bell with late-night hours listed through 3 a.m. on several days.
cards.evidence_claim: The location listing reports 9 a.m.–3 a.m. hours Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday through Saturday, with Tuesday closing at 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours extend to 3 a.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday; Tuesday ends at 1 a.m.

cards.title: Los Humildes Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 4319 W Western Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday pickup or meal here when an earlier evening option will not do; verify holiday changes first.
cards.short_summary: A West Western Avenue restaurant listing late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Humildes lists Friday and Saturday business hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m. at its South Bend location.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday are listed until 3 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday close earlier.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza — 1811 S Ironwood Dr
cards.title: Papa Johns on South Ironwood
cards.subtitle: 1811 S Ironwood Dr, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to choose delivery or carryout, and leave time for the listed closing window on weekend nights.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery runs later on Friday and Saturday at this South Ironwood location.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and carryout until midnight on those nights, at 1811 S Ironwood Dr.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza S Ironwood Dr
cards.access_notes: Delivery is listed until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday; carryout until midnight those nights.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South Bend Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2017 South Bend Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout for a shareable option; Friday and Saturday are the location's latest listed service nights.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend Avenue pizza option listed through midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout hours until midnight Friday and Saturday at 2017 South Bend Ave.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday delivery and carryout are listed until midnight; other days end earlier.

cards.title: Steak 'n Shake on State Road 933
cards.subtitle: 52965 State Road 933 North, South Bend
cards.notes: Check the official ordering link before leaving, then use this north-side counter-service option before the listed midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A State Road 933 restaurant listed open daily until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak 'n Shake lists its 52965 State Road 933 North location open 10 a.m.–midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: McDonald's on State Route 933
cards.subtitle: 52665 Indiana State Route 933, South Bend
cards.notes: Use mobile ordering, the lobby, or drive-thru as available; this location's official listing gives a midnight close every day.
cards.short_summary: A north-side McDonald's with both lobby and drive-thru listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours until midnight daily at 52665 Indiana State Route 933.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru are listed until midnight daily.

cards.title: Wendy's on South Michigan
cards.subtitle: 4227 S Michigan, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm service before going; both the restaurant and drive-thru currently list midnight closing.
cards.short_summary: A South Michigan Wendy's listing restaurant and drive-thru service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–midnight daily at 4227 S Michigan.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are each listed until midnight daily.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Miami Street
cards.subtitle: 4615 Miami Street, South Bend
cards.notes: Keep this south-side location in mind for Friday or Saturday delivery or carryout, and place an order before its listed midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A Miami Street Pizza Hut with Friday and Saturday service listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout until midnight Friday and Saturday at 4615 Miami Street.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday delivery and carryout are listed until midnight; other days close earlier.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Eddy Street
cards.subtitle: 1234 N Eddy St, South Bend
cards.notes: Order ahead for pickup or delivery from this Eddy Street shop; its official listing shows service through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: An Eddy Street sandwich option listed until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists store and delivery hours of 9:30 a.m.–10 p.m. daily at 1234 N Eddy St.
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours are listed until 10 p.m. daily.
